title: 第392章 塔影第391章 南疆的雨
slug: 满级师妹她缺德但能打
content_zh:
林青璇盯着那张画了三遍巡逻路线的草纸，沉默了很久。树洞外面又响起蛊虫爬过淤泥的沙沙声，这一次声音比之前任何一次都更密集——十八只蛊虫的步足同时碾过淤泥，响声细碎而急促，像一把铁砂撒在湿泥地上。赵烈说得没错，新增加的六只固定岗全都面朝沼泽外围，不是在巡逻，是在等。
“它们知道有人要来。”林青璇压低声音，手指在草纸上那六个新标记上挨个点过，“但不是知道我们来了——如果它们锁定了我们的位置，来的就不只是六只固定岗，而是整窝蛊虫直接围过来。”她把草纸翻到背面，用炭条迅速画了一条毒瘴墙的简化示意图，标出固定岗的分布间隔和面向方向，“你看固定岗的朝向——全部面朝沼泽外围，没有一只面朝毒瘴墙内部。这说明它们接到的指令是警戒外来者，不是搜索已知目标。毒瘴墙里那颗种子可能感应到了沼泽外围有灵力波动——不一定是我们，也许是路过的高阶妖兽，也许是前几天在沼泽里采药的散修触动了什么禁制。它提高了警戒等级，但还没锁定任何人。”
赵烈把灵晶透镜举到右眼前透过树洞的缝隙往外看了一圈，压低声音说：“固定岗每隔三十丈一只，刚好把毒瘴墙外侧的视野盲区全部覆盖了。我们从哪个方向靠近都会被至少一只固定岗看到。但如果它们的注意力全放在沼泽外围，背对毒瘴墙——那它们的背后就是盲区。”
“你的意思是绕到毒瘴墙内侧去？”林青璇把炭条在手指间转了一圈，摇了摇头，“翻墙的时候固定岗一定会看到。毒瘴墙高十几丈，墙体本身是瘴气和蛊虫排泄物凝结成的，爬墙的时候灵力波动会直接在墙体内传导——不用固定岗看到，墙体本身就能感应到有人在爬。”
赵烈把炭条接过来，在草纸上的固定岗位置旁边加了一个小小的时间标注，然后把自己记录的三次巡逻时间并排写在一起。第一次巡逻开始时间，换岗时间。第二次巡逻开始时间，换岗时间。第三次——多了六只固定岗之后——换岗时间比前两次晚了大约小半个时辰。他把这个时间差用炭条圈出来，抬头看着林青璇：“固定岗加入之后，换岗间隔变长了。原本半个时辰换一次岗，现在多了小半个时辰。这多出来的小半个时辰，是所有蛊虫同时回巢的时间——巡逻队和固定岗一起撤。”
林青璇盯着那个被圈出来的时间差，眼睛微微眯起来。蛊虫同时回巢——那就是所有蛊虫在同一时间全部撤回毒瘴墙内部，墙体外侧会出现一个完全没有蛊虫值守的空窗期。虽然这个空窗期很短，但足够一个人从隐蔽位置快速接近毒瘴墙。
“下一个换岗周期是什么时候？”
赵烈看了一眼记录：“按第三次换岗的时间往后推，下一次同时回巢应该在不到半个时辰之后。如果规律不变的话。”
“继续观察。再等一个周期。如果同一个时间差重复出现两次以上，就可以确认是固定规律。”
赵烈应了一声，重新把灵晶透镜举到眼前，在草纸上继续画观察记录表。树洞里重新安静下来，只有炭条在草纸上划过的沙沙声。林青璇靠在树洞内壁上，闭上眼睛，把感字诀玉简握在手心里激活了三分之一——不完全激活，只是让触觉和听觉略微增强一点，够听到毒瘴墙内侧的低频震动就够了。她听到了墙体内瘴气翻滚的闷响，听到了蛊虫步足在墙根淤泥里来回移动的声音，听到了更远处塔的方向传来一阵极低极缓的嗡鸣——不是灵力波动，更像是某种巨大生物缓慢呼吸时胸腔里发出的共振。她把感字诀压了回去，睁开眼看着赵烈正在记录的草纸，没有把那个声音说出来。
第四个观察周期结束时，赵烈把四张记录表一字排开，炭条点在每一张表的时间差标注上。他的手有点抖，不是因为冷，是因为兴奋——那种在大量枯燥数据里终于抓到了一个清晰规律的兴奋。“第二次换岗空窗期和第一次完全一样。巡逻队和固定岗同时撤回，空窗时间大约小半个时辰。规律确认了。”
“收拾东西。下一次空窗期我们翻墙。”林青璇把静字诀玉简收回怀里，开始快速整理装备。她把金刚绳从腰间解下来换了一根更短的，两头各系了一个快拆扣——一头扣在自己腰带后腰位置，另一头扣在赵烈的腰带前腰位置。两人之间的绳长缩短到不到一丈。“翻墙时你紧贴在我后面，我踩哪里你踩哪里。墙体是瘴气和蛊虫排泄物凝结成的，踩上去会微微下陷，但不会碎。最要紧的是灵力——全程关闭灵力运转，纯靠肉身力量爬。瘴气墙对灵力波动极其敏感，一丝灵力外泄都能顺着墙体传到塔底。”
赵烈把灵能弩的弩弦松了半圈减小走火风险，将探测阵盘从腰间解下来塞进储物袋最深处——翻墙时腰侧不能有任何凸起物，否则墙体一蹭就会卡住。他把所有装备重新捆紧，抬头看着林青璇，郑重地点了点头。
下一个空窗期到来时，天已经快黑了。沼泽上空的灰黄色云层被夕阳从下方照亮，像一块烧得半透的旧铁板倒扣在头顶。毒瘴墙外侧最后一只固定岗蛊虫缓缓转身，迈开六条步足朝墙体爬去，它的身体在接触到墙面的瞬间融入灰黄色的瘴气中，只留下淤泥里一串浅浅的足印。林青璇在心里默数了十息，确认所有蛊虫全部回巢，然后从树洞里无声地钻出来，猫着腰朝毒瘴墙快步移动。
她在墙根下找到了一个稍微凹陷的位置——墙体在这里有一个极浅的内弧，刚好够两个人贴墙站着不被远处看到。她伸手按在墙面上试了一下触感，墙体表面是粗糙的颗粒状，像干涸的泥浆混着碎石子，用力按下去会微微凹陷，但整体结构是紧实的，能承受一个人的体重。她朝赵烈打了个手势，双手抠住墙面凸起的颗粒，开始攀爬。
攀爬的过程比预想的更消耗体力。墙体没有可以抓握的凸起，只能靠手指抠进颗粒之间的缝隙借力，每一步都要先用脚尖在墙面上试探几个位置才能找到一个踩得住的着力点。林青璇爬得很稳，每一步踩实了才换手，不急不躁。赵烈紧跟在后面，林青璇踩过的位置他原样踩上去，林青璇抓过的缝隙他原样抓上去。两人之间不到一丈的金刚绳始终绷得不紧不松。
爬到大约七八丈高时，林青璇的右手忽然抠进了一个比之前所有缝隙都更深更软的位置——那不是墙体颗粒之间的缝隙，而是一只半融化的死蛊虫嵌在墙体里。虫尸被瘴气腐蚀得只剩一层半透明的壳，手指抠进去的瞬间壳就碎了，一股黏稠的灰黄色液体从碎裂处涌出来，顺着墙面淌下。林青璇感到自己的右手手指猛地一滑，整个身体的重量全部压在了左手和右脚尖上。她闷哼一声，左手五指死死抠住墙面缝隙不松手，右腿快速往上移了半步，脚尖踩进一个新的着力点，稳住身体。然后她慢慢把右手从死蛊虫的残骸里抽出来，在防水斗篷上擦掉黏稠的液体，重新找了一个干燥的位置抓稳。
金刚绳在她身后轻轻抖了一下——赵烈感觉到她身体往下滑的瞬间就本能地绷紧了绳子，但他没有用力拉。云杳杳教过他：攀爬时如果前面的人打滑，后面的人不要拉绳子，越拉前面的人越难找回平衡。正确的做法是绷紧绳子保持不动，让前面的人自己调整重心。他做到了。
林青璇稳下来之后回头看了他一眼。隔着防瘴面纱看不清她的表情，但她右手朝他比了个拇指。然后她继续往上爬。
翻过墙顶的那一瞬间，两人同时看到了塔。万毒窟的九层塔，在傍晚最后一缕天光里映出一个巨大的沉默的剪影。地上五层是灰黑色的石砌塔身，每一层都比下一层收窄一圈，塔檐上挂满了经幡一样的布条——但那些不是布条，是无数条蛊虫结成的虫茧串，从塔檐垂下来，被风一吹就轻轻摇晃。地下四层埋在沼泽里看不见，但林青璇知道它们就在那里，每一层都比上一层更黑更冷，最底下那层空心祭坛里悬浮着一颗比人还高的黑色巨茧。她想起了沈月的声音——她说“茧子表面的裂缝全张开了，里面全是眼睛”。她把目光从塔身上移开，深吸一口气，开始往下爬。

下墙比上墙更难。墙体内侧的瘴气浓度比外侧高得多，每往下一尺空气里的腐骨花朽叶甜味就更浓一分，防瘴面纱的滤芯已经在超负荷运转，千层草的苦味和银叶菊的涩味被压到了极限。林青璇在离地面还有大约一丈时直接松手跳了下去，落在墙根内侧的淤泥里打了个滚卸掉冲击力，蹲起来的同时已经拔出了剑。
塔前广场是一片被夯实的硬土，寸草不生，地面上刻满了密密麻麻的符文纹路——和焚风谷地下主阵台上的符文同一种风格，但面积更大，纹路更深，每一道符文的沟槽里都流淌着极淡极暗的紫色光芒，从塔底深处顺着符文纹路往上蔓延，像树根一样铺满了整片广场。广场上散布着十几只正在缓慢爬行的蛊虫——和墙外巡逻的不同，这些蛊虫的体型更大，背上甲壳发黑，步足末端的爪钩在硬土地上刮出浅浅的白痕。它们没有固定路线，在广场上以看似随机的轨迹缓缓移动，但林青璇很快就发现，不管怎么随机，没有一只蛊虫会踩到符文纹路。它们避开符文的方式不像是有意识的行为——符文纹路上流淌的紫色光芒对蛊虫来说大概就像滚烫的铁板对人一样，本能地不敢触碰。
林青璇把感字诀玉简激活了三分之一，耳朵里立刻涌进了塔的方向传来的低频嗡鸣声——和她之前在树洞里听到的一样，但在这里更清晰了。嗡鸣声是有节奏的，一明一暗，一明一暗，节奏很慢，慢到每一次间隔都够她数完十次心跳。沈月说过这个节奏——她在地下九层打扫祭坛时，巨茧表面的紫色光芒一明一暗，慢到让人心跳也跟着它变慢。
赵烈无声地落在她旁边，落地时金刚绳被淤泥吸住发出了一声极轻微的咕叽。两人同时僵在原地，目光扫向广场上最近的那只大型蛊虫。蛊虫停了下来，六条步足微微弯曲，触须在空中转了半圈——然后继续朝另一个方向爬去。淤泥吸住靴子的声音被它判定为沼泽自然沉降，不是敌情。
林青璇拉着赵烈退到墙根内侧一处被坍塌的土石掩埋了大半的废弃石龛后面。石龛里原本大概供着什么神像，现在只剩半截石台，石台上积了一层厚厚的蛊虫蜕壳碎片，边缘已经风化得酥脆，踩上去会发出极细微的咔嚓声。她用手指在石龛内壁上敲了敲，确认墙体是实心的，然后蹲下来从储物袋里掏出赵烈的探测阵盘，调整到被动接收模式放在石台上。阵盘屏幕无声地亮起来，地脉波动曲线在屏幕上以极稳定的频率跳动着，接收灵敏度的指示格一格一格亮到标准值。
“这里离塔不到一百丈。周围有十几只大型蛊虫在游荡，它们会避开符文纹路。符文纹路上流淌的紫色光芒是从塔底深处顺着纹路漫上来的——这些符文是塔底混沌之种输送灵能的网络末梢，铺满了整片广场。”林青璇把防水斗篷往石龛内侧挪了挪，遮住阵盘屏幕的微光，“塔本身的灵能波动极强，阵盘在这种环境下检测到的地脉波动数据会被塔本身的灵能波动淹没。你把阵盘接收灵敏度调到最高，用高频滤波把塔本身的低频振动过滤掉——如果阵盘有这个功能的话。过不掉的话就手动记录，把每一个异常的波动都记下来。”
赵烈把阵盘接收灵敏度调到最高，开始仔细辨认屏幕上那些密密麻麻的波动线条。这和在沙柳镇监测空洞深度完全不同——那里的地脉信号清晰明确，空洞的位置和深度像一块凹陷的疤痕一样一目了然。这里的信号被塔本身的灵能波动搅成了一锅粥，几十条不同频率的波动线叠在一起，粗的细的快的慢的，混成一片密密麻麻的波形，看得人眼花缭乱。他深吸了一口气，开始一条一条地拆。
林青璇在他旁边蹲下来，把静字诀重新激活，然后拿出镜字诀玉简握在左手心里。她没有立刻激活镜字诀——镜面虽然是被动接收能量波动，但激活的一瞬间会产生一股极微弱的灵力涟漪，这股涟漪在空旷的广场上可能会被大型蛊虫感应到。她要等，等下一波塔底嗡鸣声达到峰值时再激活，让嗡鸣声本身的能量波动盖过镜面激活的涟漪。
她等了大约半盏茶的工夫。塔的方向传来的嗡鸣声渐渐增强，节奏不变，但每一次嗡鸣的振幅都在缓慢爬升——爬到一个峰值后停顿了片刻，然后开始缓慢下降。她在峰值停顿的那一瞬间激活了镜字诀。神识镜面在她识海里无声地打开，镜面对准塔底方向，被动接收从茧子表面散发出来的灵力波动。反射回来的信号只有主动探测的三成强度，模糊得像是隔着一层毛玻璃在看水里的倒影，但她还是看清了几个关键信息。
茧子还在原地。茧子表面的灵力波动是增强的——比她预估的更强。那团毛玻璃般模糊的紫色光团在镜面反射里呈现出一种极不规则的脉动，不是均匀的心跳，而是一种时而急促时而平缓的混乱节奏，像是茧子内部有什么东西在挣扎。最让她在意的是——茧子周围有一圈密密麻麻的小光点正在围着茧子缓慢旋转。那些光点极小极密，数量多到数不清，旋转的轨迹规则而均匀，像极了蛊虫围绕蜂巢盘旋时的轨迹。沈月说过，每天都会有人把一批蛊虫送到茧子下面，蛊虫爬上去就再也下不来了，茧子会把它们吸进去。但镜面反射里那些光点不是在爬向茧子——它们在围着茧子绕圈，像是在守护。
茧子不是在吸收蛊虫。它在孵化蛊虫。那些围着它旋转的光点不是被送进去的祭品，是从它体内孵化出来、正在等待破茧而出的新蛊虫。
林青璇把镜字诀压了回去，将这个判断压在心底，继续用感字诀监听着塔的方向。塔底嗡鸣声在峰值停顿了几息后开始缓慢下降，广场上那些大型蛊虫随着嗡鸣声的下降也逐渐放慢了移动速度，有两只甚至在符文纹路旁边就地蜷缩起来，把六条步足收在腹下，像是在休息。她和赵烈轮换值守，一个盯阵盘记录地脉波动数据，一个举着灵晶透镜观察广场上的蛊虫活动规律。
后半夜的沼泽开始下起了雨。南疆的雨来得毫无征兆——先是空气里的湿度突然陡升到让人喘不过气，防瘴面纱的滤芯被水汽堵得进气量锐减，每一次呼吸都得用上比平时多一倍的力气；然后塔的方向传来雨点打在塔身上的啪啪声，声音由疏到密只用了不到十息，紧接着整片广场就被瓢泼大雨浇透了。雨水砸在硬土地上溅起一片白茫茫的水雾，符文纹路里流淌的紫色光芒在雨幕中反而更亮了——雨水不但没有浇灭符文，反而像是在给符文输送新的灵能，紫色光芒顺着纹路往上漫的速度比下雨前快了不少。
大型蛊虫在雨幕中显得极其烦躁。它们不再按照固定轨迹游荡，而是开始在广场上原地打转，有些甚至相互撞在了一起。撞上的蛊虫会用步足相互推搡，推搡几息后又各自分开继续打转，整个过程没有任何声音——蛊虫不会叫，它们的全部交流都靠触须之间的灵力信号传递，而这些信号在暴雨中显然受到了严重干扰。
赵烈放下灵晶透镜，揉了揉眼睛。暴雨打在石龛顶部的土石上，泥水顺着裂缝往下淌，他不得不用防水斗篷一角遮着阵盘屏幕防止被溅湿。阵盘上记录到的地脉波动数据在暴雨开始后出现了剧变——波动频率突然加快，幅度突然增大，像是塔底深处有什么东西被暴雨惊醒了，正从半休眠状态快速转入活跃状态。他把这些异常数据一笔一笔记在草纸上，笔迹因为手指冻得发僵而略显潦草，但每一个数字都清晰分明。
林青璇蹲在石龛入口，雨水从防水斗篷的帽檐边缘成串地往下滴，滴在她膝头的剑鞘上。她透过雨幕死死盯着塔的方向，把塔底嗡鸣声的每一次起伏、广场上蛊虫的每一次异常反应都默默记在脑子里。这场雨来得太突然，但南疆沼泽的雨本来就毫无规律可循，也许只是巧合。但符文纹路里的紫色光芒在雨中反而增强——这不太像巧合。这座塔，或者说塔底那颗茧子，能够从雨水中吸收能量。每一滴雨落在符文纹路上，都等于是在给它注入了新的灵力。
天快亮时雨停了。沼泽上空的灰黄色云层被晨光撕开了一道口子，一束淡金色的日光从裂缝中漏下来，正好照在塔的最高层。塔身第五层的塔檐上那些虫茧串被雨水洗过之后在日光下泛着湿漉漉的暗光——然后她看到那些虫茧串动了。不是被风吹动的那种动，是茧子本身从内部往外一鼓一鼓的，像是有什么东西在里面拼命往外顶。
第一只破茧的蛊虫从茧串最末端钻出来时，浑身裹着一层黏稠的半透明胎衣，六条步足蜷在腹下还没完全伸展开。它用口器咬破胎衣，将前足搭在破裂的茧壳边缘，慢慢把整个身体拉了出来。甲壳还是软的，在晨光下泛着一层浅淡的灰白色，接触到空气后迅速硬化变黑。不到百息，它就在晨光里完全长成了一只硬壳蛊虫，从茧串上一跃而下落在塔檐上，沿着塔身往下爬去。
紧接着是第二只、第三只、第四只。塔檐上那些虫茧串在晨光的照耀下开始大面积孵化，数不清的新生蛊虫同时破茧而出，塔身从第五层到第一层被一层蠕动着的灰白色覆盖了厚厚一层，新生的蛊虫在塔身上乱爬，有些爬到一半掉下来落在广场上，摔了个六脚朝天，翻过身来继续朝广场外爬去。
林青璇和赵烈同时屏住了呼吸。赵烈慢慢伸手把探测阵盘屏幕上的蛊虫孵化数据全部记录下来，笔尖在草纸上微微发抖——不是冻的，是震惊。万毒窟不是一个蛊虫培育基地，万毒窟本身就是一只蛊虫。塔底那颗茧子是母体，塔身上的虫茧是孵化器，每天早上天一亮孵化器就会被日光激活，批量孵化出新蛊虫补充到广场上。蛊虫的数量根本不是固定的——它们是会自我补充的，像蜂巢里的工蜂一样，死掉多少就孵化多少。只要母体还在，塔的防御就永远不会被消耗殆尽。

Lin Qingxuan stared at the piece of paper with the patrol route drawn three times and was silent for a long time. The rustling sound of Gu worms crawling through the mud was heard outside the tree hole again. This time the sound was denser than ever before - the feet of eighteen Gu worms were running through the mud at the same time. The sound was fine and rapid, like a handful of iron sand sprinkled on the wet mud. Zhao Lie was right. The six newly added fixed posts all faced the outskirts of the swamp. They were not patrolling, but waiting.
"They know someone is coming." Lin Qingxuan lowered her voice and clicked her fingers on the six new marks on the papyrus paper one by one. "But they don't know that we are coming - if they lock our position, it will not just be the six fixed posts, but the whole nest of Gu insects will come directly." She turned the straw paper to the back and quickly drew a simplified diagram of the miasma wall with a charcoal strip, marking the distribution intervals and facing directions of the fixed posts. "Look at the fixed posts. Their orientations are all facing the outside of the swamp, and none of them are facing the inside of the poisonous miasma wall. This shows that the order they received is to warn outsiders, not to search for known targets. The seed in the poisonous miasma wall may have sensed spiritual energy fluctuations outside the swamp. It may not be us, but it may be the high-level monsters passing by, or the casual cultivators who were collecting medicine in the swamp a few days ago have triggered some restrictions. It has raised the alert level, but it has not locked anyone. "
Zhao Lie raised the spiritual crystal lens to his right eye and looked around through the gap in the tree hole. He lowered his voice and said, "There are fixed posts every thirty feet, which just covers all the blind spots outside the poisonous miasma wall. No matter which direction we approach, we will be seen by at least one fixed post. But if their attention is all on the outside of the swamp, with their backs to the poisonous miasma wall - then there is a blind spot behind them."
"You mean to go around the inside of the poisonous miasma wall?" Lin Qingxuan turned the charcoal strip between her fingers and shook her head. "The fixed posts will definitely see it when climbing over the wall. The poisonous miasma wall is more than ten feet high, and the wall itself is made of miasma gas and poison excrement. When climbing the wall, the spiritual energy fluctuations will be transmitted directly within the wall - you don't need the fixed posts to see it, the wall itself can sense someone climbing."
Zhao Lie took the charcoal strip, added a small time mark next to the fixed post position on the straw paper, and then wrote the three patrol times he recorded side by side. The first patrol start time and the changing of the guard time. The start time of the second patrol and the changing of the guard time. The third time - after six more fixed guards were added - the guard changing time was about half an hour later than the previous two times. He circled the time difference with a charcoal strip and looked up at Lin Qingxuan: "After the fixed posts were added, the interval between guard changes became longer. Originally, the guard was changed every half an hour, but now it is half an hour longer. This extra half hour is the time for all the Gu insects to return to their nests at the same time - the patrol team and the fixed posts are withdrawn together."
Lin Qingxuan stared at the circled time difference and narrowed her eyes slightly. The poisonous insects return to their nests at the same time - that is, all the poisonous insects return to the inside of the poisonous miasma wall at the same time, and there will be a window period outside the wall where there are no poisonous insects on duty. Although this window period is short, it is enough for one person to quickly approach the Poison Miasma Wall from a hidden position.
"When is the next changing of the guard cycle?"
Zhao Lie took a look at the record: "If we push back the time of the third changing of the guard, the next time we return to the nest at the same time should be less than half an hour later. If the rules remain unchanged."
"Continue to observe. Wait for another cycle. If the same time difference occurs more than twice, it can be confirmed that it is a fixed pattern."
Zhao Lie responded, raised the spiritual crystal lens to his eyes again, and continued to draw the observation record sheet on the straw paper. The tree hole became quiet again, with only the rustle of charcoal strips scratching on the straw paper. Lin Qingxuan leaned against the inner wall of the tree hole, closed her eyes, held the Jade Slip of Senzi Jue in her hand and activated it by a third - not fully activated, just to slightly enhance the sense of touch and hearing, enough to hearLow-frequency vibrations to the inside of the miasma wall are enough. She heard the muffled sound of miasma rolling inside the wall, heard the sound of Gu insects moving back and forth in the mud at the base of the wall, and heard a very low and slow hum coming from the direction of the tower further away - not a fluctuation in spiritual power, but more like the resonance in the chest of some giant creature when it breathed slowly. She pressed back the Senzi Jue, opened her eyes and looked at the papyrus Zhao Lie was recording, without saying the sound.
At the end of the fourth observation period, Zhao Lie lined up the four record sheets and clicked the charcoal strip on the time difference mark on each sheet. His hands were shaking a little, not because of cold, but because of excitement - the excitement of finally catching a clear pattern in a large amount of boring data. "The window period for the second guard change is exactly the same as the first one. The patrol team and fixed posts were withdrawn at the same time, and the window period was about half an hour shorter. The pattern was confirmed."
"Pack up your things. Let's climb over the wall during the next window." Lin Qingxuan took the Jingzi Jade Slip back into her arms and began to quickly organize her equipment. She took off the diamond rope from her waist and replaced it with a shorter one, and tied a quick-release buckle on each end - one end was buckled at the back of her belt, and the other was buckled at the front waist of Zhao Lie's belt. The length of the rope between the two shortened to less than a foot. "When you climb over the wall, you stick close behind me, and you step where I step. The wall is made of miasma and poisonous excrement. It will sink slightly when you step on it, but it will not break. The most important thing is spiritual power - shut down the operation of spiritual power at all times, and rely solely on physical strength to climb. The miasma wall is extremely sensitive to fluctuations in spiritual power, and any leakage of spiritual power can be transmitted along the wall to the bottom of the tower."
Zhao Lie loosened the crossbow string of the psychic crossbow half a turn to reduce the risk of fire, took off the detection array plate from his waist and stuffed it into the deepest part of the storage bag - there should be no protrusions on the waist side when climbing over the wall, otherwise it will get stuck if it rubs against the wall. He tied all the equipment tightly again, looked up at Lin Qingxuan, and nodded solemnly.
When the next window came, it was almost dark. The gray-yellow clouds over the swamp were illuminated from below by the setting sun, like a half-burnt old iron plate lying upside down overhead. The last stationary Gu insect on the outside of the poisonous miasma wall slowly turned around, took six steps and crawled towards the wall. Its body melted into the gray-yellow miasma the moment it touched the wall, leaving only a series of shallow footprints in the mud. Lin Qingxuan counted ten breaths silently in her mind to confirm that all the Gu insects had returned to their nests. Then she silently emerged from the tree hole and moved quickly toward the poisonous miasma wall.
She found a slightly recessed position under the wall - the wall had a very shallow inner arc here, just enough for two people to stand against the wall without being seen from a distance. She stretched out her hand and pressed it against the wall to test the feel. The surface of the wall was rough and granular, like dried mud mixed with gravel. It would dent slightly when pressed hard, but the overall structure was tight and could bear a person's weight. She gestured to Zhao Lie, grabbed the raised particles on the wall with both hands, and began to climb.
The climb was more physically demanding than expected. There are no protrusions on the wall that can be grasped, so you can only rely on your fingers to dig into the gaps between the particles to gain strength. At every step, you have to test several positions on the wall with your toes to find a strong point to step on. Lin Qingxuan climbed very steadily, changing hands only after stepping firmly on each step, without being impatient or impatient. Zhao Lie followed closely behind, stepping on the spots where Lin Qingxuan had stepped on, and grabbing on to the gaps where Lin Qingxuan had grabbed. The diamond rope less than ten feet between the two of them was always neither tight nor loose.
When they climbed to about seven or eight feet high, Lin Qingxuan's right hand suddenly dug into a position that was deeper and softer than all the previous gaps - it was not a gap between the particles of the wall, but a half-melted dead Gu worm embedded in the wall. The insect corpse was corroded by the miasma until only a translucent shell remained. The shell shattered the moment a finger dug in, and a thick gray-yellow liquid gushes out from the crack and drips down the wall. Lin QingXuan felt the fingers of her right hand slip suddenly, and the entire weight of her body rested on her left hand and right toes. She groaned, holding the five fingers of her left hand firmly on the gap in the wall without letting go. She quickly moved her right leg up half a step, stepping on a new point of strength with her toes to stabilize her body. Then she slowly pulled her right hand out of the remains of the dead Gu insect, wiped off the sticky liquid on the waterproof cloak, and found a dry place to hold on to.
The diamond rope shook slightly behind her - Zhao Lie instinctively tightened the rope the moment he felt her body sliding down, but he did not pull hard. Yun Yaoyao taught him: If the person in front slips when climbing, the person behind should not pull the rope. The more the person in front pulls, the harder it will be for the person in front to regain balance. The correct approach is to tighten the rope and keep it still, and let the person in front adjust their center of gravity. He did it.
After Lin Qingxuan calmed down, she looked back at him. Her expression couldn't be seen clearly through the anti-miasma veil, but she gave him a thumbs-up with her right hand. Then she continued climbing.
The moment they climbed over the top of the wall, they both saw the tower at the same time. The nine-story tower of Ten Thousand Poison Cave reflected a huge silent silhouette in the last ray of skylight in the evening. The five floors above ground are made of gray-black stone. Each floor is narrower than the next one. The eaves of the tower are covered with cloth strips like prayer flags - but those are not cloth strips, but strings of cocoons formed by countless Gu insects. They hang from the eaves of the tower and sway gently when the wind blows. The four underground floors are invisible in the swamp, but Lin Qingxuan knows they are there. Each floor is darker and colder than the previous one. In the hollow altar at the bottom, there is a giant black cocoon that is higher than a human being. She remembered Shen Yue's voice - she said, "The cracks on the surface of the cocoon have all opened, and there are eyes inside." She looked away from the tower, took a deep breath, and began to climb down.
Going down the wall is harder than going up the wall. The concentration of miasma on the inside of the wall is much higher than that on the outside. The sweetness of rotting bones, flowers and leaves in the air becomes stronger with every foot you go down. The filter element of the anti-miasma veil is already overloaded, and the bitter taste of paper-leaf grass and the astringent taste of gualbert are suppressed to the limit. When Lin Qingxuan was about a foot away from the ground, she let go and jumped down. She landed in the mud on the inside of the wall and rolled over to relieve the impact. She squatted down and drew her sword at the same time.
The square in front of the tower is a piece of hard, compacted soil with no grass growing. The ground is covered with dense rune patterns - the same style as the runes on the main underground formation in Foewind Valley, but larger in area and with deeper lines. A very light and dark purple light flows in the grooves of each rune. It spreads upward from the bottom of the tower along the rune lines, covering the entire square like tree roots. There are more than a dozen Gu insects crawling slowly on the square - different from the ones patrolling outside the wall, these Gu insects are larger in size, with black carapace on their backs, and the claw hooks at the end of their feet scrape shallow white marks on the hard ground. They had no fixed route and moved slowly in the square in seemingly random trajectories, but Lin Qingxuan soon discovered that no matter how random, not a single Gu insect would step on the rune patterns. The way they avoid the runes doesn't look like conscious behavior - the purple light flowing on the rune lines is probably like a hot iron plate to humans, and they instinctively dare not touch it.
Lin Qingxuan activated the Jade Slip of Senzi Jue by one-third, and her ears were immediately flooded with a low-frequency hum coming from the direction of the tower - the same as what she heard in the tree hole before, but it was clearer here. The buzzing sound was rhythmic, one light and one dark, one light and one dark. The rhythm was so slow that each interval was enough for her to count ten heartbeats. Shen Yue had said this rhythm - when she was cleaning the altar on the ninth floor underground, the purple light on the surface of the giant cocoon flickered on and off, so slowly that one's heartbeat slowed down with it.
Zhao Lie landed next to her silently. When he landed, the diamond rope was sucked by the mud and made a very slight gurgle. The two of them froze in place at the same time, looking towardsThe nearest large Gu insect in the square. The Gu insect stopped, its six legs bent slightly, and its tentacles made a half circle in the air - and then continued to crawl in the other direction. The sound of mud sucking boots was judged by it to be the natural settlement of the swamp, not an enemy situation.
Lin Qingxuan pulled Zhao Lie back to an abandoned stone niche on the inside of the wall that was mostly buried by collapsed earth and rocks. There was probably some kind of statue in the stone niche, but now only half of the stone platform is left. There is a thick layer of Gu insect shell fragments accumulated on the stone platform. The edges have been weathered and become crispy, and there will be a slight clicking sound when stepped on. She tapped her fingers on the inner wall of the stone niche to confirm that the wall was solid. Then she squatted down and took out Zhao Lie's detection array disk from her storage bag, adjusted it to passive reception mode and placed it on the stone platform. The array disk screen lit up silently, the ground pulse wave curve beat on the screen at an extremely stable frequency, and the receiving sensitivity indicator bars lit up to the standard value one by one.
"This place is less than a hundred feet away from the tower. There are more than a dozen large Gu insects wandering around, and they will avoid the rune patterns. The purple light flowing on the rune patterns is coming up from the depths of the tower along the lines - these runes are the ends of the network of chaos seeds at the bottom of the tower that transmit spiritual energy, covering the entire square." Lin Qingxuan moved the waterproof cloak to the inside of the stone niche, covering the array screen. Shimmer, "The psychic energy fluctuations of the tower itself are extremely strong. The ground pulse fluctuation data detected by the array disk in this environment will be overwhelmed by the psychic energy fluctuations of the tower itself. Adjust the receiving sensitivity of the array disk to the highest level and use high-frequency filtering to filter out the low-frequency vibrations of the tower itself - if the array disk has this function. If it cannot pass, record it manually and write down every abnormal fluctuation."
Zhao Lie adjusted the reception sensitivity of the array disk to the highest level and began to carefully identify the dense undulating lines on the screen. This is completely different from monitoring the depth of the cavity in Shaliu Town - the leyline signal there is clear and unambiguous, and the location and depth of the cavity are as clear as a sunken scar. The signal here was turned into a pot of porridge by the spiritual energy fluctuations of the tower itself. Dozens of wave lines of different frequencies were stacked together, thick, thin, fast, and slow, blending into a dense waveform that was dizzying. He took a deep breath and began to tear it apart one by one.
Lin Qingxuan knelt down next to him, reactivated the Jing Zi Jue, then took out the Jade Slip of the Mirror Zi Jue and held it in her left hand. She did not activate the Mirror Art immediately - although the mirror passively receives energy fluctuations, it will produce a very weak spiritual ripple at the moment of activation. This ripple may be sensed by large Gu insects in an open square. She had to wait until the next wave of buzzing at the bottom of the tower reached its peak before activating it, so that the energy fluctuations of the buzzing sound itself would overwhelm the ripples activated by the mirror.
She waited for about half a cup of tea. The buzz coming from the direction of the tower gradually intensified, the rhythm remained unchanged, but the amplitude of each buzz was slowly climbing - it reached a peak, paused for a moment, and then began to slowly decline. She activated the Mirror Art at the moment when she paused at the peak. The mirror of consciousness opened silently in her sea of ​​consciousness. The mirror pointed towards the bottom of the tower and passively received the fluctuations of spiritual power emanating from the surface of the cocoon. The reflected signal was only 30% of the intensity of active detection, and was as blurry as looking at the reflection in water through a layer of frosted glass, but she could still see several key information clearly.
The cocoon is still in place. The spiritual power fluctuations on the surface of the cocoon were enhanced - stronger than she expected. The blurry purple light ball like frosted glass showed an extremely irregular pulsation in the mirror reflection. It was not a uniform heartbeat, but a chaotic rhythm that was sometimes rapid and sometimes gentle, as if something was struggling inside the cocoon. What concerned her most was that there was a dense circle of small light spots around the cocoon that was slowly rotating around the cocoon. Those light spots are extremely small and dense, with countless numbers. Their rotating trajectories are regular and even, like extremelyThe trajectory of the poisonous insects as they circle around the hive. Shen Yue said that every day someone would send a batch of voodoo insects under the cocoon. If the voodoo bugs climbed up and could not come down again, the cocoon would suck them in. But those light spots in the specular reflection are not crawling towards the cocoon - they are circling around the cocoon, as if they are guarding it.
The cocoon is not absorbing the poisonous insects. It's hatching bugs. Those light spots spinning around it are not the sacrifices that were sent in, but the new Gu insects that hatched from its body and are waiting to emerge from the cocoon.
Lin Qingxuan suppressed the Mirror Jue, suppressed this judgment in her heart, and continued to use the Senzi Jue to monitor the direction of the tower. The buzzing sound at the bottom of the tower paused for a few breaths and then began to slowly decrease. The large Gu insects in the square gradually slowed down as the buzzing sound dropped. Two of them even curled up on the spot next to the rune patterns, with their six legs tucked under their bellies, as if they were resting. She and Zhao Lie took turns on duty, with one watching the formation disk to record earth pulse fluctuation data, and the other holding a spiritual crystal lens to observe the activity patterns of Gu insects in the square.
It started to rain in the swamp in the latter part of the night. The rain in southern Xinjiang came without any warning - first, the humidity in the air suddenly rose so sharply that it made people breathless, and the filter element of the anti-miasma veil was blocked by water vapor, so that the air intake was reduced sharply. Every breath required twice as much effort as usual; then there was the sound of raindrops hitting the tower from the direction of the tower. The rain splashed on the hard ground and splashed a white mist. The purple light flowing in the rune lines became brighter in the rain. Not only did the rain not extinguish the runes, but it seemed to convey new spiritual energy to the runes. The purple light spread along the lines much faster than before the rain.
The large Gu insect looked extremely agitated in the rain. They no longer wandered along a fixed trajectory, but began to circle in circles in the square, and some even bumped into each other. The Gu bugs that collided would push each other with their legs, and after pushing for a few breaths, they would separate and continue to spin. The whole process would be silent - the Gu bugs would not scream, and all their communication would be transmitted through spiritual signals between their tentacles, and these signals were obviously severely disturbed in the heavy rain.
Zhao Lie put down the spiritual crystal lens and rubbed his eyes. The heavy rain hit the earth and rocks on the top of the stone niche, and muddy water dripped down the cracks. He had to use a corner of his waterproof cloak to cover the array screen to prevent it from being splashed. The ground pulse fluctuation data recorded on the array disk changed dramatically after the heavy rain began - the frequency of fluctuations suddenly accelerated, and the amplitude suddenly increased. It was as if something deep under the tower was awakened by the heavy rain and was quickly switching from a semi-dormant state to an active state. He wrote down these abnormal data on the piece of paper one by one. The handwriting was slightly sloppy because his fingers were stiff from the cold, but every number was clear and distinct.
Lin Qingxuan squatted at the entrance of the stone niche, raindrops dripping down from the brim of the waterproof cloak and onto the scabbard on her knees. She stared in the direction of the tower through the rain curtain, silently remembering every ups and downs of the buzzing at the bottom of the tower and every abnormal reaction of the Gu insects in the square. This rain came too suddenly, but the rain in the swamps of southern Xinjiang has no rules, maybe it's just a coincidence. But the purple light in the rune patterns intensified in the rain - this didn't seem like a coincidence. The tower, or rather the cocoon at its base, absorbs energy from rainwater. Every drop of rain falling on the rune lines is equivalent to injecting new spiritual power into it.
The rain stopped just before daybreak. The gray-yellow clouds above the swamp were torn open by the morning light, and a beam of pale golden sunlight leaked from the crack, shining right on the highest level of the tower. The strings of cocoons on the eaves of the fifth floor of the tower were washed by the rain and glowed wetly in the sunlight - and then she saw the strings of cocoons moving. It's not the kind of movement caused by the wind, it's the cocoon itself that swells from the inside out.It was bulging, as if there was something inside trying to push out.
When the first Gu worm that emerged from the cocoon emerged from the end of the cocoon string, it was wrapped in a layer of sticky translucent afterbirth, and its six legs were curled up under its abdomen and had not yet fully expanded. It bites open the afterbirth with its mouthparts, puts its front feet on the edge of the broken cocoon, and slowly pulls the entire body out. The carapace was still soft, glowing with a light grayish-white color in the morning light, but quickly hardened and turned black when exposed to the air. In less than a hundred breaths, it fully grew into a hard-shelled Gu insect in the morning light, jumped from the cocoon string, landed on the eaves of the tower, and crawled down the tower body.
Then came the second, third, and fourth. The strings of insect cocoons on the eaves of the tower began to hatch on a large scale under the sunlight of the morning. Countless newborn Gu insects emerged from their cocoons at the same time. The tower body was covered with a thick layer of squirming gray-white from the fifth floor to the first floor. The newborn Gu insects crawled around the tower. Some of them fell off halfway and landed on the square. They fell onto their backs, turned over and continued to crawl out of the square.
Lin Qingxuan and Zhao Lie held their breath at the same time. Zhao Lie slowly stretched out his hand to record all the Gu insect hatching data on the screen of the detection array. The tip of his pen trembled slightly on the paper - not from the cold, but from shock. Ten Thousand Poison Cave is not a Gu insect breeding base, Ten Thousand Poison Cave itself is a Gu insect. The cocoon at the bottom of the tower is the mother body, and the cocoon on the tower is the incubator. Every morning at dawn, the incubator will be activated by sunlight, and new Gu insects will be hatched in batches and added to the square. The number of Gu worms is not fixed at all - they replenish themselves, like worker bees in a hive, hatching as many as they die. As long as the mother body remains, the tower's defenses will never be exhausted.
